phase_name: Measurement Execution Record Deficiency Return and HALT Rules Design
phase_japanese_name: 測定実行記録不備時の差し戻し・HALTルール設計
purpose: Design return (remediation) and HALT procedures for Phase 19-1 and 19-2 measurement execution record deficiencies, covering format validation failures, evidence lock failures, tamper detection events, and irrecoverable integrity violations

scope_1_deficiency_classification.description: Classify record deficiencies into remedial, recoverable, or terminal categories

category_1_format_deficiency.description: Phase 19-4 format validation fails due to missing fields, wrong types, or violated enums
failure_examples: SECTION_MISSING: One or more of 5 sections absent
EXECUTION_STEPS_INCOMPLETE: Fewer than 7 steps recorded
MANDATORY_FIELD_NULL: Required field is null in completed record
ENUM_VIOLATION: integrated_decision_result not in [GO, NO_GO]
TIMESTAMP_FORMAT_VIOLATION: RFC 3339 format not followed
HASH_FORMAT_VIOLATION: evidence hash not 64+ hex characters
category_1_format_deficiency.remediation_action: RETURN → Submitter corrects specific fields → Re-submit → Re-run Phase 19-4

category_2_business_logic_violation.description: Phase 19-4 business logic rules fail (cross-field inconsistency, state invariant violations)
failure_examples: BL_1 violation: integrated_decision_before != NO_GO in Phase 19-1
BL_2 violation: receiver_validator_permission_before != NOT_EFFECTIVE
BL_3 violation: phase_18_6_final_abort_verification_result != FINAL_ABORT_VERIFICATION_PASSED
BL_4 violation: GO/NO_GO determination inconsistent with criteria evaluations
BL_5 violation: Sequential mode but Phase 15-7 result is not GO
BL_6 violation: Execution step timestamps not monotonically increasing

remediation_action.BL_1_or_BL_2: HALT → STATE_INVARIANT_VIOLATION: unauthorized state change detected before execution. Security investigation required.
remediation_action.BL_3: RETURN → Re-run Phase 18-6 ABORT verification. Do not accept record without FINAL_ABORT_VERIFICATION_PASSED.
remediation_action.BL_4: RETURN → Re-evaluate all criteria and regenerate determination. Re-submit corrected record.
remediation_action.BL_5: HOLD → Phase 15-7 must complete with GO result. Then re-submit Phase 19-2 record.
remediation_action.BL_6: RETURN → Correct execution step timestamps. Investigate clock synchronization issue.

category_2_business_logic_violation.halt_required: BL_1 and BL_2 only (state invariant violations require HALT)

failure_examples: Hash computation fails (infrastructure error)
Authority signature generation fails (key unavailable, signing error)
Audit trail append fails (storage error)
Lock entry integrity verification fails after append
category_3_evidence_lock_failure.remediation_action: HOLD → Identify and resolve infrastructure/signing issue → Retry Phase 19-5 locking procedure
category_3_evidence_lock_failure.authority_approval_for_remediation: No (infrastructure fix) except for authority key unavailability (Yes)

category_4_tamper_detection.description: Phase 19-5 tamper detection rules (TD_1 through TD_5) detect evidence modification after locking
failure_examples: TD_1: Hash recompute mismatch (record modified after locking)
TD_2: Authority signature invalid/revoked/expired
TD_3: Secondary tamper checksum mismatch (lock entry modified)
TD_4: Lock entry missing from audit trail (evidence loss)
TD_5: Measurement result summary in lock entry differs from full record
category_4_tamper_detection.remediation_action: HALT → Security incident response. Tampered records cannot be remediated; must re-execute measurement.

failure_examples: Timestamp ordering inconsistent (Phase 15-7 after 15-8 in sequential mode)
Authority identities inconsistent without documented delegation
Phase 18-8 authorization references invalid or different records
Pre-execution state snapshots logically inconsistent
Post-state transitions inconsistent with determined results
category_5_cross_validation_failure.remediation_action: HOLD or HALT depending on root cause (see scope_3 decision table)

scope_2_return_procedure.description: Return (差し戻し) procedure for remediable deficiencies

step_1_identify_failing_rules.action: Collect all failing rule IDs from Phase 19-4 validation (e.g., FT_2, BL_4, SC_2)
step_1_identify_failing_rules.output: List of failing rule IDs with failure descriptions

step_2_classify_failures.action: Map each failing rule to deficiency category (category_1 through category_5)
step_2_classify_failures.halt_check: If any failure maps to category_4 (tamper) or HALT-required category_2 (BL_1/BL_2): route to HALT immediately

step_3_generate_return_notice.action: Generate formal return notice documenting deficiencies

return_notice_content.re_submission_constraints: Conditions for re-submission (e.g., re-run Phase 19-4, re-execute Phase 15-7/15-8)

step_4_notify_submitter.action: Notify submitting authority of return notice via secure channel

step_5_remediation_and_resubmission.action: Submitter corrects deficiencies and re-submits corrected record

field_correction_only.procedure: Correct specific fields → Re-submit same execution record → Re-run Phase 19-4
field_correction_only.note: Do not re-execute measurement unless step-level data is incorrect

criteria_re_evaluation.procedure: Re-evaluate all GO/EFFECTIVE criteria → Update section_2 and step_5 → Re-submit → Re-run Phase 19-4

re_execution_required.applicable_to: category_2 BL_3 (ABORT verification not passed), BL_5 (sequential dependency)
re_execution_required.procedure: BL_3: Re-run Phase 18-6 verification → BL_5: Wait for Phase 15-7 GO result. Only then re-execute measurement and re-fill Phase 19-1/19-2 template.

step_6_re_validation_after_resubmission.action: After re-submission, re-run Phase 19-4 format validation on corrected record
step_6_re_validation_after_resubmission.failure_outcome: Iterate: re-classify failures and issue new return notice if still failing

halt_scenario_1_state_invariant_violatio.trigger: BL_1 or BL_2 violation: integrated_decision_before != NO_GO (Phase 19-1) or receiver_validator_permission_before != NOT_EFFECTIVE
halt_scenario_1_state_invariant_violatio.severity: CRITICAL - unauthorized state change before measurement

halt_procedure.step_2: Preserve the violating record as evidence (do not modify)
halt_procedure.step_3: Alert authority: state invariant violated before execution
halt_procedure.step_4: Security investigation: determine how state was changed without authorization
halt_procedure.step_5: Remediation: restore correct state, identify and revoke unauthorized change
halt_procedure.step_6: Executive authority approval to resume measurement
halt_procedure.step_7: Re-execute full Phase 18-6 ABORT verification before re-attempting measurement

halt_scenario_1_state_invariant_violatio.re_measurement_allowed: Yes, after investigation complete and executive approval obtained

halt_scenario_2_tamper_detected.trigger: Any Phase 19-5 tamper detection rule (TD_1 through TD_5) detects modification

halt_procedure.step_1: HALT all measurement and cross-validation activity immediately
halt_procedure.step_2: Preserve all evidence (locked records, audit trail) for forensics
halt_procedure.step_4: Forensic investigation: determine scope of tampering
halt_procedure.step_5: Remediation: restore from backup if available; harden infrastructure
halt_procedure.step_6: Executive + security authority approval to resume
halt_procedure.step_7: Re-execute Phase 15-7 and/or 15-8 from scratch with fresh records

halt_scenario_2_tamper_detected.re_measurement_allowed: Yes, only after investigation + approval + fresh execution (cannot re-use tampered records)

halt_scenario_3_cross_validation_critica.trigger: Phase 19-3 cross-validation fails with integrity-level inconsistency (e.g., both records show identical execution_record_ids, timestamps identical but results different, same hash but different content)
halt_scenario_3_cross_validation_critica.severity: CRITICAL - logical impossibility suggests tampering or system fault

halt_procedure.step_2: Preserve all records and locks for forensics
halt_procedure.step_3: Determine root cause: data corruption, deliberate tampering, or system fault
halt_procedure.step_4: Authority review: determine whether re-measurement is possible or root cause must be resolved first
halt_procedure.step_5: If re-measurement possible: re-execute from Phase 18-6 ABORT verification

halt_scenario_4_audit_trail_evidence_los.trigger: TD_4: lock entry missing from audit trail or audit trail corrupted

halt_procedure.step_2: Attempt to restore audit trail from backup (if available)
halt_procedure.step_3: If backup available: verify restore integrity → re-verify all lock entries present
halt_procedure.step_4: If no backup: permanent evidence loss; executive decision on whether to re-execute

halt_scenario_4_audit_trail_evidence_los.re_measurement_allowed: Yes after audit trail restored; otherwise executive decision required

scope_4_decision_table.description: Consolidated decision table mapping deficiency type to RETURN or HALT

decision_table.deficiency_type: LOGIC: BL_3 ABORT verification not passed
LOGIC: BL_5 sequential dependency not met
CROSS_VAL: Logical impossibility (identical IDs, hash/content mismatch)

phase_19_6_completion_criteria: 5 deficiency categories classified (format, logic, lock failure, tamper, cross-validation)
4 HALT scenarios designed (state invariant, tamper, cross-validation critical, evidence loss)
Decision table (13 rows mapping deficiency to RETURN/HOLD/HALT) designed
No changes to app/ or tests/ directories
